general.colorThemeHint: Works with both light and dark mode.
general.animatedBackgroundHint: Adds a living scene (e.g. the Full Moon 🌕 night sky) for scenic themes. Automatically paused under reduced-motion.
general.quitPolicyHint: Applies when sessions are running or processes are left over. "Keep" still stops sessions and Devdy helpers.

mascot.title: DY Mascot
mascot.enabledHint: Enabled by default. When off, the floating mascot is hidden app-wide.
mascot.modeHint: Inside app keeps the fox within the Devdy window. Desktop pet floats it in a frameless, always-on-top window over your desktop.
mascot.soundHint: Let the fox speak the bubble text aloud with your system's text-to-speech when it has something to say.
mascot.agentSpeechHint: When enabled, important moments can wait for a lightweight AI call so the mascot comments on the actual session result. Off by default.
mascot.voiceHint: The fox speaks the bubble text with the system voice matching the app language. Install more voices in macOS System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Manage Voices.
mascot.liteHint: Trims the heaviest visual effects (glow tails, orbit blur, ground-dot density) for weaker machines. All motion stays; effects look slightly simpler. "Auto" enables lite mode when a weak machine is detected (few CPU cores or low RAM).
mascot.previewHint: Pick a state to preview its animation, sound and speech bubble together.
mascot.testBubbleSample: Heads up — this is a sample notification.

levels.currentHint: The fox levels up on its own as you spend tokens — no manual setup. After the peak realm it reincarnates and earns a star ⭐, so levels never cap out.
levels.previewHint: Pick a realm and tier to preview how the level will appear in the mascot preview.

changes.tier1: Freshly entered realm: the aura shifts lightly while breathing and eyes feel steadier.
changes.tier2: Energy becomes clearer: brighter eyes and a stronger ground ring.
changes.tier3: Spiritual energy gathers: small spark beats appear while AI is thinking or running tools.
changes.tier4: Near completion: tails and energy streams become stronger during loading.
changes.tier5: Realm complete: the badge becomes more prominent and is ready for the next breakthrough effect.

mcp.title: Built-in MCP Server
mcp.devdyHint: Injects a built-in devdy MCP server into every run so the AI can use your own data while chatting — quick notes, cross-session recall, project context (file tree & git) and managed VPS. Tools appear as mcp__devdy__*; write & remote actions still go through the permission prompt. Takes effect on the next run.

google.title: Google Account (Drive + Gmail + Calendar)
google.intro: Connect one or more Google accounts so the AI can work with your Drive files, Gmail and Calendar. Tools appear as mcp__google__* in three groups — drive_*, mail_* and cal_*; with multiple accounts the AI targets one via each tool's account argument (the default account when omitted). Write, delete, share and send actions still go through the permission prompt, and calendar attendees are never emailed unless the AI explicitly asks to notify them. Refresh tokens are stored in your OS Keychain (never written to disk). Takes effect on the next run.
google.credsWarning: Create your own OAuth Desktop app credentials in Google Cloud Console, enable the Drive API, Gmail API and Calendar API, then paste the Client ID and Secret below.
google.loginExpired: Google session expired or was revoked. Click "Login" to re-authorize.
google.missingScopes: This account is missing permissions ({scopes}) — it was connected before they were added, so some APIs (e.g. Calendar) return 401. Click "Login" to re-authorize.
google.loggingIn: Opening browser to sign in again…
google.credsSaved: OAuth credentials saved — no need to re-enter them.
google.enterLabel: Enter a label for the account (e.g. work, personal).
google.enterBothCreds: Enter both Client ID and Client Secret.
google.removeMessage: The AI will lose access to this account. Your saved OAuth credentials are kept so you can re-add it without re-entering them.
google.forgetMessage: This removes the stored Client ID/Secret and ALL connected accounts. You will need to paste the credentials again next time.

github.title: GitHub Accounts
github.intro: Add GitHub accounts once and link them to projects. PATs are stored securely in your OS Keychain (never written to disk). Required scopes: repo (private) or public_repo (public).
github.isolationWarning: Keep this machine logged out of gh globally: do not run gh auth login or set GH_TOKEN system-wide. Devdy wires the correct per-project credential at run time; a global login would let runs bypass that isolation.
github.patPlaceholder: New PAT (leave blank to keep current)
github.deleteMessage: Delete this GitHub account? Projects linked to it will be unlinked.

gitlab.title: GitLab Accounts
gitlab.intro: Add GitLab accounts once and link them to projects. PATs are stored securely in your OS Keychain (never written to disk). Set a custom host for self-hosted GitLab, and an optional commit email. Required scope: api (or read_api + write_repository) — a repository-only token is rejected by the validation endpoint.
gitlab.isolationWarning: Keep this machine logged out of glab globally: do not run glab auth login or set GITLAB_TOKEN system-wide. Devdy wires the correct per-project credential at run time; a global login would let runs bypass that isolation.
gitlab.patPlaceholder: New PAT (leave blank to keep current)
gitlab.deleteMessage: Delete this GitLab account? Projects linked to it will be unlinked.

aws.title: AWS Accounts
aws.intro: Add AWS accounts once and link one account to each project. Secret Access Keys and Session Tokens are stored securely in your OS Keychain. Devdy wires the selected project account to Claude and Codex runs through the broker.
aws.isolationWarning: Avoid setting AWS credentials globally for agent work. Devdy gates aws calls through its broker; credential/config mutation such as aws configure is blocked.
aws.ssoExpired: SSO token expired or not signed in. Click "SSO login" to sign in again.
aws.newSecretPlaceholder: New Secret Access Key (leave blank to keep current)
aws.sessionTokenReplacePlaceholder: Session Token (optional; set when replacing secret)
aws.profileAllAdded: All profiles from ~/.aws/config are already added
aws.ssoLoginNeeded: SSO token missing or expired — sign in to list accounts.
aws.ssoUseManual: Enter a profile name manually instead
aws.ssoUsePicker: Pick a role via SSO instead
aws.deleteMessage: Delete this AWS account? Projects linked to it will be unlinked.

claude.title: Claude Accounts
claude.intro: Manage multiple Claude Code subscription logins. Each account is isolated in its own profile (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), so you can run in parallel with different accounts and link a specific account per project.
claude.securityNote: Devdy never stores your Claude password or OAuth token — Claude Code owns the credential. Adding or removing an account here never touches your global ~/.claude login.
claude.addHint: Create a profile slot, then a terminal opens to log in with the Claude CLI for that profile.
claude.loginOpened: Opened a terminal to log in — finish the Claude login there, then click Check.
claude.validNeedsLogin: Not logged in yet — click Login to authenticate
claude.deleteMessage: This removes the account from Devdy and unlinks it from any projects. Your global ~/.claude login is not affected.

balance.title: Auto-balance default
balance.hint: Automatically point the default at the least-used account so plan usage spreads evenly. New runs that aren't pinned to a project follow it; running/resumed runs keep their account.
balance.suggest: Suggestion: switch the default to {account} to balance usage.

ai.title: AI & Models
ai.reloadCodexModelsTitle: Refresh the model list from the Codex CLI (codex debug models)
ai.validateModelsTitle: Run a one-word turn on each model to see which ones your Claude account still serves (uses a little quota)
ai.validateHint: Not checked yet — click Validate to see which models your account still serves.
ai.validateRunning: Checking each model against your account…
ai.validateError: Validation failed — could not run the check.
ai.modelsRefreshError: Refresh failed — keeping the last cached list.
ai.codexRefreshHint: Not refreshed yet — using the built-in list. Click Refresh to load models from the Codex CLI.
ai.codexStaticHint: Codex does not support dynamic model listing — this list is fixed.
ai.permissionHint: How tool calls are gated (Claude & Codex). "Ask via UI" surfaces each request in a modal; "Bypass all" skips the modal — fast, but unsafe outside trusted directories. You can still override engine, model and permission mode per run on the Run screen.
ai.translationHint: Used for translating highlighted text in the Run AI screen.
ai.translateModelHint: "Default" → picks a fast model (Claude uses Haiku) for faster translation.

usage.title: Usage & Budget
usage.contextMeterHint: Shows how full the current run's context window is. The bar turns amber past the warn threshold and offers a one-click /compact.
usage.limitOverrideHint: Leave the override empty to auto-resolve from the model (Claude 200k / 1M, Codex 272k).
usage.budgetHint: Checked before each run & follow-up: Devdy blocks a new run (override per turn) when the run's engine reaches a limit below. Thresholds map to that engine's real subscription plan windows (from /usage) — a rolling 5h window and a weekly window (resets per account). A run is blocked if any set window is reached. Codex usually exposes only the weekly window, so set Weekly to cover it. Leave a field empty to skip that window; with no plan data (e.g. API-key sessions) the guardrail is inactive.

prompts.title: Prompt Templates
prompts.libraryHint: Pick these from the dropdown in the chat box to reuse them without retyping.
prompts.deleteMessage: The prompt will be removed from your library and cannot be recovered.
prompts.bodyPlaceholder: The prompt text to insert into the chat box…

inboxApi.title: Inbox API (Chrome extension)
inboxApi.help: A local HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1 only) the Chrome extension sends Slack thread links to (/v1/slack-threads). It also offers translation at /v1/translate. Paste the base URL and token into the extension.
inboxApi.enableHint: When off, nothing listens on the port.
inboxApi.regenerateMessage: The current token stops working immediately; the extension must be updated with the new one. Continue?

azure.title: Azure Accounts
azure.intro: Add Azure accounts and link one to each project. Each account is its own az login, isolated and managed by Devdy, so several tenants and identities can coexist. az and terraform in runs of a linked project use that account.
azure.isolationWarning: Avoid relying on a global az login for agent work. Devdy keeps each account's Azure CLI session in its own directory and points runs at the linked one.
azure.loginExpired: Not signed in, the Azure session expired, or it was signed in without MFA (Azure blocks all write operations). Click "Sign in" to sign in again and complete MFA.
azure.addHint: Adding an account opens your browser for az login. Leave tenant empty to use your home tenant, and subscription empty to use its default subscription.
azure.addWaiting: Complete sign-in in your browser. This waits up to about 5 minutes.
azure.addLoginFailed: Azure sign-in did not complete. If the account now appears in the list, click "Sign in" on it; otherwise add it again.
azure.deleteMessage: Delete this Azure account and its sign-in session? Projects linked to it will be unlinked.

backup.title: File backup
backup.help: Export your whole Devdy setup to one file and import it on another machine: app settings, saved prompts, the Skills / Rules library with groups, MCP servers, VPS servers, accounts (GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Azure, Google, Claude), notes / todos and Slack threads (with translations; attachments are downloaded again) and projects (repos, enabled Skills / Rules / groups, MCP and VPS servers, linked accounts). Session history stays on this machine.

export.title: Export
export.includeSecretsHint: PATs, MCP env/header values, Google tokens, SSH passphrases and imported private keys — sealed with your password.
export.passwordWarning: Devdy cannot recover this password. Without it the secrets in the file cannot be restored.
export.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {n} characters.
export.noSecretsHint: Without secrets, accounts must be re-authenticated after import. The file still contains your notes — keep it private.

import.title: Import
import.help: Items are merged by name: matching items are overwritten with the imported version, new ones are added, nothing on this machine is deleted. Replaced Skill / Rule files are moved to the legacy backups.
import.passwordHint: Leave empty to import without secrets.
import.createMissingDirsHint: Paths under the old home folder are moved under this machine's home first. A project whose folder still does not exist gets an empty folder; when this is off, that project is skipped.

report.title: Import result
report.secretsImported: Secrets were restored into the Keychain.
report.reloginHint: Claude and Azure logins never travel: log in to those accounts again, and validate AWS profiles on this machine.

sync.title: Sync
sync.help: Keep one shared Devdy state across your machines: settings, library, notes / todos, Slack threads, projects and sessions — and, if you want, the project folders themselves. Nothing syncs on its own: press Sync on the machine that should receive, while the source machine has Devdy open. Everything goes through your relay end-to-end encrypted.

create.title: Create a sync group
create.help: On your first machine. Uses the relay configured in Remote Control.

join.title: Join a sync group
join.help: On another machine: enter the device name and master password of a machine already in the group (both set in its Remote Control settings). On that machine, open Settings → Sync → Accept a new device first, then allow the request there.
join.alias: Device name of the other machine
join.aliasInvalid: Device names use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
join.previewHelp: What the first sync brings in and how it matches this machine's existing data. Nothing local is deleted.
join.pendingHelp: This machine joined a sync group but has not merged its data yet. Syncing starts after the merge.
join.previewFailed: Could not load the merge preview
join.missingHelp: {n} project(s) are not on this machine yet: pick their folders under "Project folders" after merging.
join.undecryptable: {n} item(s) from the relay could not be decrypted and will be skipped.
join.waiting: Waiting for approval on the other machine…

secrets.label: Sync secrets
secrets.hint: Tokens and passwords from the Keychain, sealed with the group key. Turn off to keep them on this machine only.

devices.title: Devices
devices.leaderHelp: The selected device runs singleton jobs (Slack re-fetch) so they don't run twice. Changes apply right away.
devices.noLeader: No leader — every device runs them

confirmRemove.title: Remove device?
confirmRemove.message: {name} will no longer be able to sync. Its local data stays on it, and it keeps the old group key but can no longer reach the group's data on the relay.

devices.creator: Created the group
devices.removeHelp: A removed device keeps its copy of the group key but can no longer reach the group's data on the relay (the key is not rotated in this version).
devices.onlyCreator: Only the device that created the group ({name}) can remove devices.
devices.leaderPending: {name} has not confirmed it took over the background jobs yet (it may be offline). This device keeps running them until it does.

projects.title: Project folders on this machine
projects.help: Projects from your other machines and where they live here. Pick a folder for those not on this machine yet.
projects.tabHelp: Which projects this machine receives, and where their folders live here. Folder sync makes the folder identical to the source machine (branch, commits, uncommitted changes, other files) after a preview.

state.create: + create (not here yet — will be cloned)

resync.hint: Upload this machine's full state again

confirm.title: Re-sync everything?
confirm.message: This machine's whole state is uploaded again. Useful after a long time offline or if devices drifted apart.

leave.offline: Left the sync group (the relay could not be reached; remove this device from another one)

confirm.title: Leave the sync group?
confirm.message: This machine stops syncing. Its local data stays; to join again you need another device's name and master password.

handoff.title: Leave without handing on its role?
handoff.message: This device runs the group's background jobs (Slack polling) or created the group, and the relay could not be reached to hand that role to another device. If you leave now, the other devices keep waiting for it: pick a new leader on one of them afterwards. Go back online (and unpause sync) to hand it on properly.

sync.relayMissing: This machine has no relay of its own yet: set the relay URL and token in Settings → Remote Control first.

errors.host_offline: No machine answered on that device name. Check the name and that it is online.
errors.host_not_in_group: That machine is not in a sync group.
errors.host_unsupported: That machine's Devdy is too old to add devices. Update it first.
errors.not_accepting: That machine is not accepting new devices. On it, open Settings → Sync → Devices → Accept a new device, then try again.
errors.declined: The request was declined or not answered in time on that machine.
errors.busy: That machine is busy with other requests. Try again in a moment.
errors.relay_not_configured: This machine has no relay of its own yet: set the relay URL and token in Settings → Remote Control first.
errors.relay_error: That machine could not reach the relay. Try again.
errors.sync_bootstrap_runs_live: Stop running sessions on this machine before merging.
errors.ticket_required: The relay needs a join ticket from a device already in the group. Ask that device to accept this one again.
errors.ticket_invalid: The join ticket expired or was already used. Join again.
errors.group_exists: That sync group already exists on the relay.
errors.forbidden: Only the device that created the group can remove devices.
errors.quota_exceeded: The relay storage quota for this group is full.
errors.device_revoked: This device was removed from the sync group. Leave the group, then join again.
errors.sync_bootstrap_not_pending: There is no merge waiting on this machine.
errors.sync_bootstrap_in_progress: Sync is merging this machine's data. Try again in a moment.
errors.auth_failed: The relay refused this machine's relay token. Check the relay URL and token in Settings → Remote Control.
errors.relay_behind: The relay lost changes this machine already received (it was restored from a backup). Sync is stopped until this machine merges with the group again.
errors.sync_leave_handoff_pending: This device leads the group's background jobs or created the group, and the hand-off could not be completed (the relay or the new leader could not be reached).
errors.peer_offline: The source machine is offline — open Devdy on it and try again.
errors.peer_paused: Sync is paused on the source machine. Resume it there, then try again.
errors.peer_timeout: The source machine did not answer in time. Check that it is awake and online, then try again.
errors.sync_not_connected: This machine is not connected to the relay yet. Wait a moment and try again.

accept.title: Accept a new device
accept.help: To add a machine, open this for 5 minutes, then start Join on the other machine. You confirm each request here; keep this page open until it is done.

request.title: Allow “{name}” to join sync?
request.message: It gets the group key and everything that syncs (including secrets when secret sync is on). Only allow a machine you are setting up right now.

parked.title: Changes the relay refused
parked.help: The relay permanently refused these changes (too large or malformed), so they are not synced and no longer block the others. Editing the row again queues it as usual; Retry sends the current version now.

ondemand.header: On-demand sync: only runs when you press Sync
ondemand.noSource: No other device in this group yet. Press Accept a new device below, then Join the group from the other machine.
ondemand.offlineHelp: {name} is offline — open Devdy on that machine and try again
ondemand.pending: Changes waiting to be sent: {n} (sent when another machine syncs from this one)
ondemand.pauseHelp: Paused: this machine does not answer Sync requests from other devices.

data.help: What this machine receives when you press Sync.
data.note: Turning a category on downloads all of it again on the next Sync. Turning one off keeps the data already here.

config.label: General settings
config.hint: App settings that apply on every machine

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.hint: GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Azure, Google and Claude accounts

secrets.label: Include tokens / secrets
secrets.hint: Keychain values, sealed with the group key

mcp.label: MCP servers
mcp.hint: MCP server configs and per-project selection

notes.label: Notes & Todos
notes.hint: Notes, todos, Focus day plans and their session links

projectDialog.title: {name} — sync settings
projectDialog.extra: Extra patterns (one per line, gitignore style)
projectDialog.maxInvalid: Enter a whole number of MB (1–100000).

run.title: Sync from {name}

phase.flushing: {name} is sending its changes ({n} so far)…

run.noFolders: No project has folder sync on.

preview.localChanges: This machine has {n} uncommitted change(s) → backed up first
preview.tooLarge: {n} file(s) over the size limit are skipped
preview.rewound: branch {branch} will be moved back; its old tip is kept in devdy-sync-backup/…

skipped.running_session: a session is running on this machine

run.stopped: Stopped — the next Sync continues where it left off.

skipItem.branch_in_worktree: branch checked out in another worktree
skipItem.changed_since_preview: changed since the preview — left as is
skipItem.ref_conflict: branch name clash — repo left as is

run.planChanged: The source folder changed after this preview, so nothing beyond it was written. Review the new preview and confirm again.
